failure.title: Concurrent mutation workers produced systemic Vitest runtime errors
failure.note: The quiet-host mutation report contained 1,556 RuntimeError mutants with the same Vitest unhandled Pool.run failure across all 22 mutated source files; 1,554 of them had covering tests.
failure.diagnosis: Stryker still launched concurrent test runners and each Vitest runner could execute files in parallel, so the PGlite/Vitest worker pool failed systemically even though Stryker itself exited successfully. Treating these harness errors as invalid mutants would have inflated the apparent score.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
